scope: Two fixed four-epoch pilots after 50 explicit human type1a decisions
checkpoint: Four fixed epochs; last.pt only; no crop-val selection
evaluation: All 93 frozen REAL VAL objects; FINAL-H OCR/profile unchanged; conf .5 / resolution640
acceptance: Both overall detector recall and FPA >= baseline; at least one strictly improves. No per-type detected/correct counts below baseline for type1/type1a/type1b.
latency: Existing mean<100ms GPU gate; peak reserved<4096MiB. GTX1050Ti timing remains unverified.
preference: Eligible candidates: maximum FPA, then recall, then lower GPU mean; unchanged baseline retained on no eligible improvement.
limitations: 90 real train objects, no real type1 train geometry; crop scale/context bias remains.
hyperparameter_search: Only two predeclared variants; settings match previous round, no grid or threshold tuning
